feed.caption:
New callout! A lost puppy at Biscuit Hill 🐶

In KidPad's Rescue activity, little ones choose the right vehicle for each emergency, then switch on the lights and siren and race to help.

Fire engines, ambulances and police cars, all in one pocket-sized rescue centre. It works offline too, so it's ready for car journeys and waiting rooms.

£2.99 once, no ads. Link in bio.
